items.mainland_price_evidence: Seller/daigou listings consistently state original price CNY 139; official public price page not yet located
items.interpretation: Cross-market resale/daigou demand is visible, but no verified completed-sale evidence has been found. Do not calculate guaranteed profit from these asks. Ticket cost and acquisition friction materially reduce margin for a buyer entering only to resell.

items.item: CHIIKAWA DAYS special ticket-set benefits: 9 name-tag charms + RFID light-up baton

market_observations.note: reservation listing; admission ticket not included in resale package

items.interpretation: Interesting freebie/bundle-value case, but current evidence is an asking price for a reservation product rather than a completed transaction.

rules_learned: Separate official/original price evidence from seller-stated original price.
Never treat a foreign-market asking price as a completed-sale price.
Include required ticket/admission cost when purchase access is ticket-holder-only.
Track free gifts and bundled benefits separately from merchandise resale value.
A long exhibition period can increase later supply; early scarcity may fade quickly.
